rules.question: The مفعول مطلق is employed to...
options: ...provide detail of the state of the subject/object when an action is conducted (حال).
...provide detail of the time in which an action is conducted (ظرف).
...provide detail of the number of times an action is conducted (عدد).
...provide detail of the method an action is conducted in (نوع).
answer: ...provide detail of the number of times an action is conducted (عدد).
...provide detail of the method an action is conducted in (نوع).

rules.question: The مفعول مطلق ...
options: ...can be a مصدر of the exact verb mentioned earlier or a synonym of the verb mentioned earlier.
...must be a مصدر of the exact verb mentioned earlier.
...can be a مصدر of any random verb.
...must be a مصدر of a synonym of the verb mentioned earlier.
answer: ...can be a مصدر of the exact verb mentioned earlier or a synonym of the verb mentioned earlier.

rules.question: The مفعول مطلق ...
options: ...can be replaced by what is known as: النائب عن المفعول المطلق
answer: ...can be replaced by what is known as: النائب عن المفعول المطلق

rules.question: The verb governing the مفعول مطلق ...
The مفعول مطلق ...
options: ...can be replaced by a word signifying abundance of the doers.
...can be replaced by a word signifying scarcity of the doers.
...can be replaced by an إسم الإشارة gesturing the type of action.
...can be replaced by a tool the action is conducted with.
...can be replaced by a word signifying a partial completion of the action.
...can be replaced by a word signifying a total completion of the action.
...can be replaced by a word signifying abundance of the action.
answer: ...can be replaced by an إسم الإشارة gesturing the type of action.
...can be replaced by a tool the action is conducted with.
...can be replaced by a word signifying a partial completion of the action.
...can be replaced by a word signifying a total completion of the action.
...can be replaced by a word signifying abundance of the action.

rules.question: The مفعول مطلق, when on the pattern of فِعْلَةٌ...
options: ...signifies the time or place the action is conducted.
...signifies the number of times the action is conducted.
...signifies the state of the doer of the action.
...signifies the method the action is conducted.
answer: ...signifies the method the action is conducted.
